note: The 90-day human schedule. Day numbers are relative to `wf roadmap` (which writes .wealforge/start.txt). Every task here is something a person must do — accounts, uploads, judgement. Edit freely; `wf today` reads this file.

1: Serve/commit the free tool; put the real URL into its canonical + CTA
Fact-check pass: verify every number and citation against a primary source today
2: Cover built from the brief; thumbnail test against a real results page
Create the marketplace account — identity verification takes ~24h, start now
3: Author profile + email publication + digital-product store, same handle everywhere
Upload ebook; answer the AI-content declaration truthfully; price from `wf price`
4: Paperback via the digital proof ($0) and approve it
Publish the pillar articles with internal links
5: Submit sitemap to Search Console and Bing (both free)
wf score so the ledger holds today's ranking, not last month's
6: Day-1 calendar post: tool first, sell second
7: Fill the tracker even with zeros — the week of zeros is the baseline later diagnosis needs

phases.name: proof
phases.goal: Evidence strangers care: 10 reviews, 50 tool visits/week

10: Format the low-content kit from the existing worksheets (a formatting job, not a writing job)
12: List the kit; add the book-owner discount line
14: Step price up to list, announced with the reason
16: Ten personal review asks, individually, no conditions attached
19: Reply to every review including the critical ones; no defensiveness
21: wf report → read the diagnosis before touching anything

phases.name: distribute
phases.goal: Two channels working, not twenty tried

24: Five community replies at full quality, no links unless asked
27: Free-promo window on the ebook if enrolled in the 90-day exclusivity programme
30: One PDF flyer to training coordinators / staff reps / department libraries
35: wf report; run exactly one experiment for 14 days
45: Decision gate: keep / repackage / pivot, using `wf report` output rather than a feeling

phases.name: compound
phases.goal: Second asset at ~20% of the first one's cost

50: wf pick on the scored ledger → the next asset is chosen by the rubric, not by boredom
60: Draft asset 2 with wf build; the gate is the same gate
75: Bundle both assets; raise the low-price product to a system price
90: Full review: revenue vs the model, hours invested per dollar, and one pivot decision
